messages:
Nadia Singh: Quick notice 0: were opening a 48-hour volunteer reviewer window to cover overflow and LOA. If you can take 1-3 extra reviews, please sign up. Need especially infra, ML infra, and product reviewers.

Owen Brooks: Link to sign-up? Also curious if this is only for final reviewers or managers too.

Nadia Singh: Form: https://forms.redwood.com/reviewer-spotlight (name, email, max extras, areas). Managers can sign up as reviewers but please don't take reviews for direct reports.

Samira Rao: I can do 2 extra for product. How will assignments be prioritized?

People Ops Bot: reminder: Backfill pool will be used after managers with <6 reviews are exhausted. Assignments prefer domain match then FIFO. See docs: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/overflow

Nadia Singh: SLA for backfill reviewers = 72h from assignment. Well tag them as "backfill" in the reviewer dashboard. If you miss SLA, People Ops will reassign and notify your manager.

Owen Brooks: Can we opt into only "short" forms? I'm happy to help with low-effort ones.

Nadia Singh: Yup adding a checkbox on the form ("short/easy forms only"). Also adding a CSV bulk upload option for team coordinators:```csv
email,max_extra,notes
owen.brooks@redwood.ai,1,easy-only
samira.rao@redwood.ai,2,product focus
```

Samira Rao: Can we get a live count of remaining unassigned high-effort forms? Would help triage.

People Ops Bot: update: exposing a simple "unassigned-high-effort-count" field in reviewer confirmation emails. Will also post hourly summary in #people-ops during the 48h window.

Nadia Singh: Thanks all. If you signed up, expect assignment emails in 6-24h. Ping me here for edge cases or manager exceptions. :thumbsup:
